title: Renewable energy partnership to help decarbonise Kruger National Park in its centenary year.
summary: Skukuza, South Africa - South African National Parks (SANParks) and Ampli Energy today announced a landmark private-sector renewable energy sponsorship agreement for South African conservation, starting with Kruger National Park (KNP) in its centenary year. The supply is equivalent to more than 25% of the park’s annual electricity consumption and will help advance KNP’s sustainability and decarbonisation goals.

# Overview


Through proprietary technologies and processes the main products Sasol produces are fuel components, chemical components and co-products. From these main products and further value-adding processes we deliver diesel, petrol (gasoline), naphtha, kerosene (jet fuel), liquid petroleum gas (LPG), olefins, alcohols, polymers, solvents, surfactants, co-monomers, ammonia, methanol, crude tar acids, sulphur, illuminating paraffin, bitumen and fuel oil. Even further processing produces numerous additional products.
